newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Nafin seeks $600 mln placements 2nd half 97.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Nafin seeks $600 mln placements 2nd half 97.

text.p: Mexico's National Development bank (Nafin) will seek to issue a total of $600 million in public and private placements, the bank's international director said.
"We intend to make public and private placements in the second half of the year for an amount...of $600 million," Nafin International Director Roberto Casillas said in an interview.
Casillas said recent operations in the international debt markets by Mexico's Finance Ministry meant better terms were now available.
"Our operations...are aimed at market niches and our funding needs are not as big (as the government's)...but we are deriving advantage from the improvement in terms," he said.
Nafin made its last international debt placement on May 22, with a $150 million issue of three-year Eurobonds.
